claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: K-strophanthidin is a cardiac glycoside that inhibits Na+/K+-ATPase; at 2.5 uM it is expected to cause only weak, non-selective cytotoxicity in the pooled screen, since cardiac glycosides are not broadly cytotoxic at low micromolar concentrations and no class in the vocabulary captures Na+/K+-ATPase inhibition.
